name: Amazon US electric grill brush category data
description: Point-in-time Amazon US category snapshot behind the Ryndix electric grill brush review: keyword demand, competing listings, price distribution, seasonality, click cost and unit economics at the median on-shelf price.

headlineVerdict: Electric grill brush, Amazon US: 63,434 monthly searches against 1,364 competing listings (supply-demand 46.5), and six listings launched one to two months ago are already selling. But a $3.57 cost per click makes the unit economics work only above $70, while the median on-shelf price is $39.99 and the 33.2% margin there cannot carry paid traffic. Verdict: conditional on pricing above $70, a click under $2.00, and shelf presence before the March peak.

unitEconomics.description: Canonical unit-economics fields for cross-category comparison. A null value means the review never recorded that measurement; see notMeasured. Values are reused from variableMeasured, not recomputed.
